title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.52
subtitle: Wetness at real-world size, five times faster.

highlights.title: Real-world proportions
highlights.description: Drops, holes and rivulets are sized in millimetres from your scene, and water stays as thin as real water on fabric, at any texture resolution.

highlights.title: Five times faster wetness
highlights.description: The TETHYS Engine uses several CPU cores and always leaves two free for Blender.

highlights.title: TETHYS Engine with its logo
highlights.description: The engine program now shows the TETHYS logo and its file details in Windows.
